status: schema.json holds the provider's 200 response schema unchanged under "response", formatted by Prettier; fixtures.json is written in Telegram because Platform publishes no fixtures. The endpoint carries no contract version, so the directory is pinned by providerCommit instead of a version suffix
extraction: gh api 'repos/sachkov-inside/platform/contents/apps/backend/openapi/platform-api.json?ref=<providerCommit>' -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' | jq '{response: .paths["/billing/cohorts"].get.responses["200"].content["application/json"].schema}', then prettier --write
